composition.story: Calling fact(3) pushes a new frame for each recursive call, each holding its own n. At the base case, the newest frame returns first and pops. Each older frame then resumes with its saved n, finishing in reverse order.

aha.observation: After fact(1) pops, fact(2) resumes with its own saved n = 2. It returns 2 × 1 = 2, so frames finish in reverse order.

states.label: Call fact(3)
states.sentence: main calls fact(3). A frame holding n = 3 is pushed onto the stack.
states.why: Every call gets its own frame.

states.label: Call fact(2)
states.sentence: fact(3) cannot finish yet, so it calls fact(2). A new frame with n = 2 sits on top.

states.label: Call fact(1): base case
states.sentence: fact(2) calls fact(1). Here n = 1 is the base case, so no further call is made.
states.why: The base case stops the growth.

states.label: fact(1) returns 1
states.sentence: fact(1) returns 1 and its frame is popped. The stack shrinks to two frames.
states.why: The newest frame leaves first (last in, first out).

states.label: fact(2) returns 2
states.sentence: fact(2) resumes with its own saved n = 2, computes 2 × 1, returns 2, and is popped.
states.why: Each frame remembered its own n while waiting.

states.label: fact(3) returns 6
states.sentence: fact(3) resumes with n = 3, computes 3 × 2, and returns 6 to main. The stack is empty.
states.why: The last frame to unwind is the first one called.
